paragraphs: I'm applying for the Finance & Strategy, Deal Velocity role in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. As more companies buy Claude, the time it takes a deal to get from quote to signed contract matters a lot, and I'd like to be the person who keeps that moving.

At Thomson Reuters I was an Order Management Associate. I helped streamline the order-to-cash process, which cut the cash conversion cycle by 20%, and I handled reconciliation with 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting. At Lenovo and JPMorgan I worked in Salesforce and other CRM tools every day, and at Lenovo I documented business requirements for stakeholders and built dashboards that saved 4+ hours a week of reporting.

Quarterbacking deals through quoting, approvals and contract execution, and spotting the patterns that slow deals down, fits how I like to work: careful with details and quick to fix a broken process. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
